genre.pop: pop music with melodic vocals and a polished pop arrangement
genre.rock: rock music with electric guitars, bass and drums
genre.electronic: electronic dance music driven by synthesizers and programmed beats
genre.rnb_soul: R&B and soul music with soulful singing and syncopated grooves
genre.hip_hop: hip hop music with rhythmic rap vocals and beats
genre.folk_acoustic: folk and acoustic music with acoustic guitar and a natural arrangement
genre.jazz: jazz music with jazz harmonies, improvisation and swing
genre.classical_orchestral: classical or orchestral music with acoustic orchestral instruments
genre.metal: heavy metal music with heavily distorted guitars and aggressive playing

emotion.joy: joyful music expressing happiness and delight
emotion.sadness: sad music expressing sorrow and sadness
emotion.anticipation: music expressing excited anticipation and romantic butterflies
emotion.longing: music expressing yearning and longing for someone or something
emotion.poignancy: heartfelt poignant music expressing an aching, pleading emotion
emotion.hope: hopeful music expressing optimism and encouragement
emotion.anxiety: anxious music expressing unease, worry and tension
emotion.anger: angry music expressing rage and hostility

mood.refreshing: music with a refreshing, airy, clear and breezy atmosphere
mood.dreamy: music with a dreamy, ethereal and floating atmosphere
mood.warm: music with a warm, soft and comforting atmosphere
mood.calm: music with a calm, peaceful and restrained atmosphere
mood.dark: music with a dark, heavy and ominous atmosphere
mood.grand: music with a grand, majestic and expansive atmosphere
mood.bouncy: music with a light, bouncy and lively atmosphere
mood.wistful: music with a wistful, hazy and nostalgic atmosphere
